board.task: THE 1,000-PAYER FUNNEL, BUILT NOT WISHED — CEO: "ways to get this app to easily pull 1000 monthly users". Math: ~1,000 payers ≈ 29-33k installs at the earned ask. Build these, in this order, each shippable without App Review: (a) EXPORT-GUIDE SEO AT SCALE — the four guides are live; take them to 20+ (ChatGPT, Claude, WhatsApp, Instagram, Netflix, Spotify, YouTube, Google Takeout, Apple Health, Reminders...). The search intent "how do I download my X data" is EXACTLY our user, at the exact moment they want it. HowTo schema on every page. (b) ANSWER-ENGINE CITATION — structure every guide so ChatGPT/Perplexity/Google AI cite it: direct answer in the first 40 words, steps as a list, a fact table, last-updated date. Being the cited source IS the new SEO. (c) THE FIRST READING SHARE CARD — a count-based, anonymised-by-construction image the person can post ("Sentr counted 4 years of my calendar and told me one thing"); no record content, ever. The artifact IS the ad. (d) THE HOOK THAT IS PRESS-WORTHY — "an app that keeps score on its own wrong predictions and shows you the misses" is a story no competitor can copy without becoming us; draft the press kit around the calibration screen, not the features. (e) APPLE FEATURING NOMINATION — free, and this app is exactly what editorial likes (privacy-first, original, beautiful); prepare the nomination packet.
